statement: The pinned Logitech DJ remove handler clears receiver readiness, cancels queued work, and destroys all paired child HID devices when any required receiver USB interface is unbound, even if other receiver interfaces are still bound. Thus failure of a shared receiver interface can remove otherwise unrelated children; this is receiver-wide failure rather than proof that an individual child-slot failure propagates.

applicability.scope: Logitech DJ receiver interface teardown and sibling-impact boundary; source-only
